short_description: UCAC4 filters, defined as Johnson B and SDSS g, r

licence.scope: No owner statement found. The USNO UCAC page SVO cites returns 403 to curl on 2026-10-26 (redirects to cnmoc.usff.navy.mil, 403); the Internet Archive capture of 17 Feb 2024 carries no licence, copyright or credit text; usno.navy.mil itself also returned 403. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

notes: DetectorType of sdss_g, sdss_i, sdss_r set to photon, DetectorTypeSource original (2026-11-11), the label every served copy of the same curve now carries: The curve is the SDSS 2001 public response table (https://classic.sdss.org/dr7/instruments/imager/, column 2: point source through 1.3 airmasses). Doi et al. (2010, AJ 139, 1628) obtain the response functions as quantum efficiency (§II), weight them 'to give the photon number' (§III, eq. 3) and integrate magnitudes as ∫d(log ν) f(ν)R(ν) (§IV, eq. 4), applied to this public table: photon counting. SVO's DetectorType is not used.
